title: Defined Terms: Continuing, Recounting and Starting a Cycle of Cancellation-Rate Warnings
content:
These defined terms of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product decide how the cancellation warning sequence number of a Wayfare driver's new cancellation-rate warning relates to the warnings before it. The cancellation warning sequence number is the number a cancellation-rate warning carries within the driver's current warning cycle.

### "Latest earlier cancellation-rate warning"

The most recent cancellation-rate warning already on the standing record when the new one is recorded. Its age is counted in whole calendar months from its date to the recording day.

### Cycle rule

- **Continue.** When the latest earlier cancellation-rate warning is dated fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the recording day, the cancellation warning sequence number continues from it, being that warning's sequence number plus one.
- **Recount.** When it is dated at least 3 but fewer than 12 whole calendar months back, the cycle is recounted, the number being one plus the earlier cancellation-rate warnings inside the cycle window.
- **Fresh cycle.** When there is no earlier cancellation-rate warning, or the latest one is dated 12 whole calendar months or more back, a fresh cycle starts and the number is one.

| Age of the latest earlier cancellation-rate warning | Cycle | Number |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 3 whole calendar months | continued | that warning's number plus one |
| 3 to 11 whole calendar months | recounted | one plus the earlier cancellation-rate warnings inside the cycle window |
| 12 whole calendar months or more, or no earlier warning | fresh | one |

### Hypothetical readings (recording day 2026-09-15)

- Latest earlier warning dated 2026-07-01, numbered 2: under 3 whole months, the cycle continues and the number is 3.
- Latest earlier warning dated 2026-06-15: exactly 3 whole months, so the cycle is recounted.
- Latest earlier warning dated 2025-09-16: 11 whole months, so the cycle is recounted.
- Latest earlier warning dated 2025-09-15: 12 whole months, so a fresh cycle starts and the number is one.
